meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会写小脚本并运行来控制浏览器：打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取网页数据、测试网站。页面状态会在多次脚本执行之间保留，脚本可逐步执行同一任务；重复操作可写成单个脚本一次跑完。
howto.when: 当你要求进行任意浏览器交互时触发，例如提到「打开某网址」「点击」「填表」「截图」「抓取」「自动化」「测试网站」「登录」等，或要求使用浏览器扩展。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图给我看
say.note: 会启动浏览器、访问该页并保存截图

say.text: 用扩展模式在我已登录的 Chrome 里操作
say.note: 会先启动中继服务并等你连接扩展

say.text: 抓取这个列表页的数据
say.note: 可拦截并重放网络请求来取数据

howto.what_en: Claude writes and runs small scripts that drive a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, test sites. Page state persists across script runs, so tasks can be done step by step, or a repeated job can be scripted once.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for any browser interaction, e.g. "go to [url]", click, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape, automate, test the website, log in, or ask to use the browser extension.

say_en.text: Go to example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Launches the browser, loads the page, saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Use extension mode in my logged-in Chrome
say_en.note: Starts the relay server and waits for the extension

say_en.text: Scrape the data from this listing page
say_en.note: Can intercept and replay network requests
